title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Holdings Reduced by Eads & Heald Investment Counsel

text:
Posted by Rob Logan on Feb 8th, 2018 // No Comments 
Eads & Heald Investment Counsel cut its position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3.8% in the 3rd quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the SEC. The fund owned 15,067 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 592 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for 1.4% of Eads & Heald Investment Counsel’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 10th biggest holding. Eads & Heald Investment Counsel’s holdings in Apple were worth $2,322,000 at the end of the most recent quarter. 
A number of other hedge funds have also recently modified their holdings of AAPL. Xact Kapitalforvaltning AB grew its position in shares of Apple by 2.2% in the second quarter. Xact Kapitalforvaltning AB now owns 889,513 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $128,108,000 after purchasing an additional 19,469 shares during the period. Centre Asset Management LLC grew its position in Apple by 2.5% during the second quarter. Centre Asset Management LLC now owns 155,878 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $22,450,000 after acquiring an additional 3,870 shares during the period. Norman Fields Gottscho Capital Management LLC grew its position in Apple by 2.9% during the second quarter. Norman Fields Gottscho Capital Management LLC now owns 36,805 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $5,301,000 after acquiring an additional 1,032 shares during the period. Needelman Asset Management Inc. grew its position in Apple by 1.0% during the second quarter. Needelman Asset Management Inc. now owns 6,081 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $876,000 after acquiring an additional 60 shares during the period. Finally, Stillwater Capital Advisors LLC grew its position in Apple by 0.4% during the second quarter. Stillwater Capital Advisors LLC now owns 104,983 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $15,120,000 after acquiring an additional 368 shares during the period. 60.23% of the stock is owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. Several equities research analysts have recently weighed in on the company. Mizuho set a $160.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “hold” rating in a research report on Wednesday, October 18th. Vetr cut Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and set a $178.34 price target on the stock. in a research note on Friday, December 1st. UBS Group set a $190.00 price target on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Friday, January 5th. Needham & Company LLC boosted their price target on Apple from $175.00 to $200.00 and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Friday, November 3rd. Finally, Morgan Stanley restated a “buy” rating and set a $205.00 price objective (up previously from $200.00) on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, January 23rd. Two investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, fifteen have given a hold rating, thirty-four have given a buy rating and two have issued a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The company has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $201.72. 
Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) traded down $3.49 during trading on Wednesday, reaching $159.54. 51,440,675 shares of the company’s stock traded hands, compared to its average volume of 34,930,000. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a current ratio of 1.24 and a quick ratio of 1.20. The firm has a market capitalization of $809,510.00, a P/E ratio of 16.41, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.19 and a beta of 1.33. Apple Inc. has a 52-week low of $130.45 and a 52-week high of $180.10. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The business’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period in the prior year, the business posted $3.36 earnings per share. equities research analysts forecast that Apple Inc. will post 11.38 EPS for the current year. 
The firm also recently announced a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 15th. Shareholders of record on Monday, February 12th will be given a dividend of $0.63 per share. This represents a $2.52 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.58%. The ex-dividend date is Friday, February 9th. Apple’s payout ratio is 25.93%.

Apple Company Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
